rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Port and Logistics Industry Division ), 051-773-5774, 5773
Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「항만운송사업법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Port Transport Business Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(항만운송에서 제외되는 운송) 「항만운송사업법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제1항제5호다목에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 운송”이란 다음 각 호의 운송을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transportation Excluded from Port Transport) In Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5, Item (c) of the Port Transport Business Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “transportation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the transport set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 선박에서 사용하는 물품을 공급하기 위한 운송
rows.text_en: 1. Transportation to supply goods used on a ship

rows.source_ko: 2. 선박에서 발생하는 분뇨 및 폐기물의 운송
rows.text_en: 2. Transportation of sewage and waste generated on ships

rows.source_ko: 3. 탱커선 또는 어획물운반선[어업장에서부터 양륙지(揚陸地)까지 어획물 또는 그 제품을 운반하는 선박을 말한다]에 의한 운송
rows.text_en: 3. Transport by tanker or catch carrier [referring to a vessel that transports catches or their products from the fishing grounds to the landing site]
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(항만의 지정) ① 법 제2조제3항제1호에서 “해양수산부령으로 지정하는 항만”이란 「항만법 시행령」 별표 1의 무역항을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Designation of Ports) ① In Article 2, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Act , the term “ports designated by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to trade ports listed in Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Port Act. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제2조제3항제2호에서 “해양수산부령으로 수역(水域)을 정하여 지정하는 항만”은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② The “ports designated by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries by defining the waters” in Article 2, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]
Chapter 2 Port Transportation Business

rows.source_ko: 제4조(항만운송사업의 등록신청) ① 법 제5조제1항에 따라 항만운송사업의 등록을 신청하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 항만운송사업 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 사업계획서와 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 12. 28., 2024. 7. 1., 2025. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Registration of Port Transport Business) ① A person who intends to apply for registration of a port transport business pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for registration of a port transport business in the form of Annex No. 1 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Governor of a Province, or Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governor”), attaching a business plan and documents classified according to the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 28, 2017; July 1, 2024; May 28, 2025>
1. If the applicant is a corporation: Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 신청인이 개인인 경우: 재산 상태를 기재한 서류
rows.text_en: 2. If the applicant is an individual: Documents stating financial status

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청서를 제출받은 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 제2호 또는 제3호의 서류를 확인하는 데에 동의하지 않으면 해당 서류를 첨부하게 해야 한다. <개정 2011. 4. 11., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 12. 28., 2024. 7. 1., 2025. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of a regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the governor of a city or province who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the documents under Subparagraph 2 or 3, the applicant shall be required to attach such documents. <Amended Apr. 11, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 28, 2017; July 1, 2024; May 28, 2025>
1. Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations)
2. Standard Financial Statement Certificate (Applicable only to existing corporations)
3. Abstract of Resident Registration (applicable only to individuals)

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 사업계획서에는 해당 사업에 제공될 시설 및 장비에 관한 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. 이 경우 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 선박국적증서를 확인하여야 하며, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 선박국적증서 사본을 첨부하게 하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 4. 11., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 12. 28., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The project plan under Paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs regarding the facilities and equipment to be provided for the relevant project. In this case, the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Mayor/Do Governor shall verify the Certificate of Nationality of the Ship through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act; if the applicant does not consent to the verification, they shall be required to attach a copy of the Certificate of Nationality of the Ship. <Amended Apr. 11, 2011; Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 28, 2017; July 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 하역장비의 종류, 명칭, 형식, 능력, 설치장소 및 소유 또는 임차의 구별을 기재한 서류와 그 사실을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents stating the type, name, model, capacity, installation location, and distinction between ownership and lease of cargo handling equipment, and documents proving such facts

rows.source_ko: 2. 선박 또는 부선(艀船)의 이름, 용도, 총톤수, 적재 톤수[예인선(曳引船)과 통선(通船)은 제외한다], 주기관(主機關)의 마력 수(예인선만 해당한다), 계류장(繫留場)의 위치 및 소유 또는 임차의 구별을 기재한 서류와 그 사실을 증명하는 서류[선박 또는 부선을 소유한 경우에는 선적증서(船籍證書)의 사본 또는 부선증서의 사본을 말한다]
rows.text_en: 2. Documents stating the name, purpose, gross tonnage, and loading tonnage of the vessel or barge [excluding tugboats and tugboats], the horsepower of the main engine (applicable only to tugboats), the location of the mooring area, and the distinction between ownership and lease, and documents proving such facts [in the case of ownership of the vessel or barge, this refers to a copy of the Certificate of Ship Registration or a copy of the Barge Certificate].

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업소, 하역장 또는 수면(水面) 목재저장소의 명칭, 위치 및 소유 또는 임차의 구별을 기재한 서류와 그 사실을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents stating the name, location, and distinction of ownership or lease of the business office, loading dock, or waterside timber storage facility, and documents proving such facts
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(사업계획) ① 법 제5조제1항에 따른 항만하역사업의 사업계획에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Business Plan) ① The business plan for port cargo handling business pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall include the following matters:
1. Project Overview
2. Number, Name, and Location of Business Offices
3. Scheduled date of business commencement

rows.source_ko: 4. 다음 각 목에 해당하는 종사자(일일고용된 사람, 3개월 이내의 기간을 정하여 사용하는 사람 및 시험적으로 사용하는 사람은 제외한다. 이하 같다)의 수
rows.text_en: 4. The number of employees falling under each of the following subparagraphs (excluding persons employed on a daily basis, persons employed for a fixed period of less than three months, and persons employed on a trial basis; hereinafter the same applies)

rows.source_ko: 가. 현장직원(작업을 기획하거나 화물을 인수ㆍ인도하는 업무에 종사하는 사람을 말한다)
rows.text_en: a. Field staff (referring to persons engaged in the work of planning operations or receiving and delivering cargo)

rows.source_ko: 나. 현장감독자(현장에서 작업을 지휘ㆍ감독하는 사람을 말한다)
rows.text_en: B. Site supervisor (referring to a person who directs and supervises work at the site)

rows.source_ko: 다. 선내(船內) 종사자(법 제2조제1항제4호에 따라 화물을 선박에 싣거나 선박으로부터 내리는 일에 종사하는 부두책임자, 갑판책임자 및 양하기(揚荷機) 책임자를 말한다)
rows.text_en: c. Onboard personnel (referring to dock managers, deck managers, and unloading machine managers engaged in loading or unloading cargo onto or from a vessel pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act)
D. Ship's crew
E. Crew of the barge

rows.source_ko: 바. 보관직원(법 제2조제1항제8호 및 제13호에 따른 행위 중 화물의 보관에 종사하는 사람을 말한다)
rows.text_en: f. Storage staff (referring to persons engaged in the storage of goods among the acts under Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 8 and 13 of the Act)
d. Construction machinery operator

rows.source_ko: 5. 사업에 제공될 시설 및 장비에 관한 다음 각 목의 사항
rows.text_en: 5. The following matters regarding facilities and equipment to be provided for the project

rows.source_ko: 가. 하역장비의 종류별 대(臺) 수 및 대별 능력
rows.text_en: A. Number of units and capacity by type of cargo handling equipment

rows.source_ko: 나. 선박의 척(隻) 수 및 척별 적재 톤수
rows.text_en: B. Number of vessels and loading tonnage per vessel

rows.source_ko: 다. 부선의 척 수 및 척별 적재 톤수
rows.text_en: C. Number of barges and loading tonnage per barge

rows.source_ko: 라. 예인선의 척 수 및 척별 주기관의 마력 수
rows.text_en: D. Number of tugboats and horsepower of main engines per unit

rows.source_ko: 마. 통선의 척 수 및 척별 총톤수
rows.text_en: E. Number of vessels and gross tonnage per vessel

rows.source_ko: 바. 상옥(上屋) 및 창고의 동(棟) 수 와 동별 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: F. Number of upper buildings and warehouses, location and area of ​​each building

rows.source_ko: 사. 하역장의 수, 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: G. Number, location, and area of ​​loading docks

rows.source_ko: 아. 수면 목재저장소의 수, 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: A. Number, location, and area of ​​timber storage facilities

rows.source_ko: 자. 종사자 대기소의 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: J. Location and area of ​​the employee waiting area
6. Specific details of the project to be carried out
7. Estimate of annual cargo volume handled

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조제1항에 따른 검수사업, 감정사업 및 검량사업의 사업계획에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The business plans for inspection, appraisal, and measurement projects under Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall include the following matters:
1. Project Overview
2. Number, Name, and Location of Business Offices

rows.source_ko: 3. 각 사업소별 검수사, 감정사 또는 검량사(이하 “검수사등”이라 한다)의 수
rows.text_en: 3. Number of inspectors, appraisers, or measuring officers (hereinafter referred to as “inspectors, etc.”) for each business office

rows.source_ko: 4. 각 사업소별 검수사등 대기소의 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: 4. Location and area of ​​waiting areas for inspectors, etc. at each business office
5. Estimated annual cargo volume handled (applicable only to inspection and weighing businesses)
6. Estimated annual number of cases handled (applicable only to appraisal business)
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(등록증의 발급) 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제5조제1항에 따른 등록신청이 같은 조 제2항에 따른 등록요건을 모두 갖추었다고 인정하는 경우에는 별지 제2호서식의 항만운송사업 등록증을 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 12. 28., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Issuance of Registration Certificate) If the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province recognizes that an application for registration under Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act satisfies all the registration requirements under Paragraph 2 of the same Article, they shall issue a Port Transport Business Registration Certificate in the form of Annex 2. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 28, 2017; July 1, 2024>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(항만하역장비의 종류) 「항만운송사업법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 별표 1에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 하역장비”는 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2013. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Types of Port Cargo Handling Equipment) The “cargo handling equipment prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Port Transport Business Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) is as set forth in Annex 2. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]
Article 8 Deleted <February 8, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(응시원서) 영 제5조제3항에 따른 검수사등 자격시험의 응시원서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application Form) The application form for the qualification examination for inspectors, etc. pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as shown in Form No. 3 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(검수사등의 등록) ① 법 제7조제1항에 따라 검수사등의 등록을 하려는 사람은 별지 제4호서식의 검수사등 등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 영 제27조제4항에 따른 한국검수검정협회의 장(이하 “한국검수검정협회장”이라 한다)에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Registration of Inspectors, etc.) ① Any person who intends to register as an inspector, etc. pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit the application for registration of inspectors, etc. in Form No. 4 of the Attached Form, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the Korea Inspection and Certification Association pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “President of the Korea Inspection and Certification Association”).
1. Copy of Resident Registration Card
2. Copy of Inspector, etc. Certificate

rows.source_ko: 3. 사진(모자를 쓰지 않은 정면 상반신 반명함판)
rows.text_en: 3. Photograph (Front-facing upper body half-size, without a hat)

rows.source_ko: ② 한국검수검정협회장은 제1항에 따라 검수사등의 등록신청서를 받았을 때에는 신청인에게 별지 제5호서식의 검수사등 수첩을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the President of the Korea Inspection and Certification Association receives an application for registration of inspectors, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall issue an inspector, etc. handbook in the form of Annex 5 to the applicant.

rows.source_ko: ③ 한국검수검정협회장은 제2항에 따라 검수사등 수첩을 발급할 때에는 등록대장에 다음 각 호의 사항을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the President of the Korea Inspection and Certification Association issues an inspector's certificate pursuant to Paragraph 2, he/she shall record the following matters in the registration ledger:

rows.source_ko: 1. 성명 및 주소(법인인 경우에는 대표자의 성명과 법인의 주소를 말한다. 이하 같다)
rows.text_en: 1. Name and address (in the case of a corporation, this refers to the name of the representative and the address of the corporation. The same applies hereinafter)
2. Classification of Inspectors, etc.
3. Registration Number and Registration Date

rows.source_ko: 4. 취업하려는 항만 및 항만운송사업의 등록을 한 자(이하 “항만운송사업자”라 한다)의 명칭
rows.text_en: 4. The name of the port where employment is to be sought and the person registered for the port transportation business (hereinafter referred to as the “Port Transportation Business Operator”)
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]
Article 11 Deleted <February 8, 1999>
Article 12 Deleted <February 8, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(검수사등의 자격증) 영 제10조에 따른 검수사등의 자격증은 별지 제8호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Certificate of Inspector, etc.) The certificate of inspector, etc. pursuant to Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의2(자격취소의 공고) 해양수산부장관은 법 제8조의3제2항에 따라 검수사등의 자격을 취소한 때에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 관보에 게재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13-2 (Public Notice of Revocation of Qualification) When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries revokes the qualification of an inspector, etc. pursuant to Article 8-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act, he/she shall publish the following matters in the Official Gazette.

rows.source_ko: 1. 자격이 취소되는 검수사등의 성명 및 생년월일
rows.text_en: 1. Name and date of birth of inspectors, etc. whose qualifications are revoked
2. Types of qualifications subject to cancellation
3. Reasons for Revocation of Qualification
[This Article Newly Inserted July 24, 2013]
Article 14 Deleted <February 8, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(운임 및 요금) ① 항만하역사업의 등록을 한 자가 법 제10조제1항 및 같은 조 제2항에 따라 운임 및 요금의 설정 또는 변경의 인가신청이나 신고를 할 때에는 별지 제9호서식의 항만하역운임 및 요금 인가(변경인가) 신청서 또는 별지 제10호서식의 항만하역운임 및 요금 신고(변경신고)서를 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 11. 28., 2017. 12. 28.>

rows.text_en: ③ A person who has registered for an inspection business, appraisal business, or measurement business shall, when filing a report on the establishment or change of charges pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Act, submit documents (including electronic documents) containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, the head of a regional maritime and fisheries office, or the mayor or provincial governor. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 28, 2017; Apr. 6, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제25조(행정처분 결과의 보고) 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제26조 또는 제26조의5에 따라 항만운송사업자 또는 항만운송관련사업의 등록 또는 신고를 한 자에 대하여 행정처분을 하였을 때에는 그 사실을 해양수산부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 12. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Reporting of Results of Administrative Dispositions) When the head of a regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the governor of a city or province has imposed an administrative disposition on a port transport business operator or a person who has registered or reported a port transport-related business pursuant to Article 26 or Article 26-5 of the Act, they shall report such fact to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 28, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제25조의2(항만종합서비스업의 등록 신청 등) ① 법 제26조의2제2항에 따라 항만종합서비스업의 등록을 신청하려는 자는 별지 제11호서식의 항만종합서비스업 등록신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 사업계획서와 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25-2 (Application for Registration of Port Comprehensive Service Business, etc.) ①person who intends to apply for registration of a port comprehensive service business pursuant to Article 26-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the head of a regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the mayor/governor of a city/province an application for registration of a port comprehensive service business in the form of Annex No. 11 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) with a business plan and the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs attached.
1. Articles of Incorporation (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 재산 상태를 기재한 서류(개인인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Documents stating financial status (applicable only to individuals)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 등록신청서를 제출받은 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 또는 주민등록표 초본(개인인 경우만 해당한다)을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 주민등록표 초본의 경우 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않으면 이를 첨부하게 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the mayor/governor of a city/province who receives the application for registration pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (only applicable to corporations) or the abstract of the resident registration record (only applicable to individuals) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, in the case of the abstract of the resident registration record, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, they must be required to attach it.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 사업계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The business plan pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall include the following items:
1. Project Overview
2. Current Status of Employees

rows.source_ko: 3. 보유 시설 및 장비의 목록과 현황
rows.text_en: 3. List and Status of Owned Facilities and Equipment

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항에 따라 항만종합서비스업의 등록을 신청하려는 자 중 선박에서 발생하는 분뇨ㆍ오물을 제거하거나 폐기물을 수집ㆍ운반하는 내용의 사업을 포함하여 수행하려는 자는 제26조제4항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Among those who intend to apply for registration of a comprehensive port service business pursuant to Paragraph 1, those who intend to carry out a business including the removal of sewage and waste generated from ships or the collection and transportation of waste must be persons falling under any of the subparagraphs of Paragraph 4 of Article 26 .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제26조의2제2항에 따른 항만종합서비스업의 등록 신청이 같은 조 제1항에 따른 등록기준을 모두 갖추었다고 인정하는 경우에는 별지 제12호서식의 항만종합서비스업 등록증을 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ If the head of a regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the mayor or provincial governor recognizes that an application for registration of a comprehensive port service business pursuant to Article 26-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act meets all the registration criteria pursuant to Paragraph 1 of the same Article , they shall issue a comprehensive port service business registration certificate in the form of Annex 12 .

rows.text_en: Article 26 (Application for Registration and Notification of Port Transport-Related Businesses) ①Any person who intends to apply for registration or make a notification of a port transport-related business pursuant to Article 26-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province an application for registration of a port transport-related business (port service business, ship fuel supply business, ship repair business, container repair business) in Form No. 14 of the Appendix (including an application in the form of an electronic document) or a notification of ship supplies business in Form No. 14-2 of the Appendix (including a notification in the form of an electronic document), attaching a business plan (excluding goods supply business) and the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 28, 2017; May 1, 2018>
1. Articles of Incorporation (submit only if applicable to a corporation)
2. Deleted <May 1, 2018>
3. Documents stating financial status

rows.source_ko: 4. 부두시설 등 항만시설을 사용하는 경우에는 해당 항만시설의 사용허가서 사본(선박수리업 및 컨테이너수리업의 경우에만 제출한다)
rows.text_en: 4. In the case of using port facilities such as dock facilities, a copy of the permit for the use of the relevant port facilities (to be submitted only in the case of ship repair and container repair businesses)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청서 또는 신고서를 제출받은 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 또는 주민등록표 초본(개인인 경우만 해당한다)을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 주민등록표 초본의 경우 신청인 또는 신고인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하면 이를 첨부하게 하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 4. 11., 2017. 12. 28., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of a regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the mayor/governor of a city or province who receives an application or report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify a certificate of corporate registration (applicable only to corporations) or an abstract of resident registration (applicable only to individuals) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 사업계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2017. 12. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ The business plan pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall include the following matters. <Amended Dec. 28, 2017>

rows.text_en: ④ Among those who intend to apply for registration of port service business pursuant to Paragraph 1, those who intend to remove sewage and waste generated from vessels or collect and transport waste must be persons falling under any one of the following subparagraphs.

2. Persons licensed for waste collection and transportation business pursuant to the Waste Management Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호 또는 제2호에 해당하는 자와 바다 위에서 분뇨나 폐기물을 운반하기로 위탁계약을 체결한 자
rows.text_en: 3. Persons falling under Subparagraph 1 or 2 who have entered into a consignment contract to transport sewage or waste at sea

rows.text_en: ⑤ When the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province receives an application for registration or a report regarding a port transport-related business pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall verify whether it complies with the standards for registration and report set forth in Annex 6 of the Enforcement Decree, and then issue to the applicant or reporter a Certificate of Registration for a Port Transport-Related Business (Port Service Business, Ship Fuel Supply Business, Ship Repair Business, Container Repair Business) in Form No. 15 or a Confirmation Certificate of Report for a Ship Supplies Supply Business in Form No. 16. rows.source_ko: ⑥ 선박연료공급업을 등록한 자가 법 제26조의3제3항에 따라 사업계획 변경신고를 하려는 경우에는 별지 제16호의2서식의 선박연료공급업 사업계획 변경신고서에 사업계획서를 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <신설 2017. 12. 28., 2018. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ In the event that a person registered for the ship fuel supply business intends to file a report of change to the business plan pursuant to Article 26-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall submit the Ship Fuel Supply Business Plan Change Report (Form No. 16-2) with the business plan attached to it to the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of the City or Province. <Newly added Dec. 28, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.text_en: ⑦ When the Head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office or the Governor of a City or Province receives a report of change to a business plan for a ship fuel supply business pursuant to Paragraph 6, if it complies with the registration standards set forth in Annex 6 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall issue a Certificate of Confirmation of Report of Change to Ship Fuel Supply Business Plan in the form of Annex 16-3, reflecting the changes . <Newly added Dec. 28, 2017; May 1, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제27조(부두운영회사의 선정기준) ① 법 제26조의6제1항에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 기준”이란 다음 각 호를 말한다. <개정 2020. 7. 30., 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Selection Criteria for Wharf Operating Companies) ① The term “criteria prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 26-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 30, 2020; October 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제26조의6제2항제3호에 따른 임대료(이하 “임대료”라 한다) 및 그 밖에 부두운영회사가 법 제2조제7항에 따른 관리청 또는 「항만공사법」에 따른 항만공사(이하 “관리청등”이라 한다)에 내야 하는 비용의 지급 능력
rows.text_en: 1. Ability to pay rent pursuant to Article 26-6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “rent”) and other expenses payable by the dock operating company to the administrative authority pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 7 of the Act or the port authority pursuant to the Port Authority Act (hereinafter referred to as “administrative authority, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 화물의 유치 능력 및 법 제26조의6제1항에 따른 부두운영계약(이하 “부두운영계약”이라 한다)으로 임차ㆍ사용하려는 항만시설 및 그 밖의 장비ㆍ부대시설 등(이하 “항만시설등”이라 한다)에 대한 투자 능력
rows.text_en: 2. Capacity to attract cargo and investment capacity for port facilities and other equipment, ancillary facilities, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “port facilities, etc.”) intended to be leased or used under a dock operation contract pursuant to Article 26-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “dock operation contract”)
3. Soundness of financial structure
4. Operation and Management Capability of Ancillary Businesses

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 기준의 세부내용에 대해서는 관리청등이 정할 수 있다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② The administrative authority, etc. may determine the details of the standards under Paragraph 1. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제28조(항만시설등의 임대료) 법 제26조의6제2항제3호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 기준”이란 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Rent for Port Facilities, etc.) The “standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 26-6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Act shall be as set forth in Annex 3 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제29조(부두운영계약의 내용) 법 제26조의6제2항제5호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Contents of Wharf Operation Contract) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 26-6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act refers to the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>
1. Matters concerning the safety management of port facilities, etc. by the dock operating company

rows.source_ko: 2. 부두운영회사의 항만시설등의 분할 운영 금지 등 금지행위 및 위반시 책임에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning prohibited acts, such as the prohibition of the divided operation of port facilities, etc. by the dock operating company, and liability in case of violation

rows.source_ko: 3. 항만시설등의 효율적인 사용 및 운영 등을 위하여 관리청등(해양수산부장관은 제외한다. 이하 제29조의2제2항 후단, 같은 조 제3항, 제29조의3제4항 및 제29조의4제2항 후단에서 같다)과 해양수산부장관이 협의한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters agreed upon between the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and the managing authority, etc. (excluding the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries; hereinafter the same applies in the latter part of Article 29-2 , Paragraph 2 , Paragraph 3 , Article 29-3 , Paragraph 4 , and the latter part of Article 29-4, Paragraph 2 ) for the efficient use and operation of port facilities, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제29조의2(부두운영회사의 선정 절차) ① 관리청등이 법 제26조의6제1항에 따라 부두운영계약을 체결하려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함한 부두운영회사 선정계획을 수립하여 항만시설을 개장(開場)하기 6개월 전까지 이를 공고하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 29-2 (Procedure for Selection of Wharf Operating Company) ① Where an administrative authority, etc. intends to enter into a wharf operation contract pursuant to Article 26-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall formulate a plan for the selection of a wharf operating company including the matters in each of the following subparagraphs and publicize it no later than six months prior to the opening of the port facilities. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>
1. Port facilities, etc. subject to the contract
2. Contract Period and Rent
3. How to Participate in the Contract
4. Selection criteria for port operating companies pursuant to Article 27

rows.source_ko: ② 관리청등은 제1항에도 불구하고 항만시설등의 효율적인 사용 및 운영 등을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 그 공고기간을 줄이거나 공고 없이 부두운영계약을 체결할 수 있다. 이 경우 관리청등은 해양수산부장관과 미리 협의할 수 있다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if the managing authority, etc. deems it necessary for the efficient use and operation of port facilities, etc., it may reduce the public notice period or conclude a pier operation contract without public notice. In such cases, the managing authority, etc. may consult with the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries in advance. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 관리청등은 부두운영계약을 체결하기 전에 부두운영계약을 체결하려는 자가 제27조에 따른 부두운영회사의 선정기준에 적합한지 여부 등에 대하여 해양수산부장관과 미리 협의할 수 있다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ Before concluding a pier operation contract, the managing authority, etc. may consult with the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries in advance regarding whether a person intending to enter into a pier operation contract meets the selection criteria for a pier operating company pursuant to Article 27. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제29조의3(부두운영계약의 갱신) ① 부두운영회사가 법 제26조의6제2항제4호에 따른 계약기간을 연장하려는 경우에는 그 계약기간이 만료되기 6개월 전까지 관리청등에게 부두운영계약의 갱신을 신청하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 29-3 (Renewal of Wharf Operation Contract) ① If a wharf operating company intends to extend the contract period pursuant to Article 26-6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , it shall apply to the competent authority, etc. for the renewal of the wharf operation contract at least six months prior to the expiration of said contract period. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 관리청등은 제1항에 따라 부두운영회사로부터 부두운영계약의 갱신 신청을 받은 경우에는 제27조에 따른 부두운영회사의 선정기준에 적합한지 여부 및 다음 각 호의 사항을 검토하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② When the administrative authority, etc. receives an application for renewal of a port operation contract from a port operating company pursuant to Paragraph 1, it shall review whether the company meets the selection criteria for port operating companies under Article 27 and the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>
1. Whether rent is overdue

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제26조의6제2항제2호에 따른 화물유치 또는 투자 계획의 이행 여부
rows.text_en: 2. Whether the cargo attraction or investment plan pursuant to Article 26-6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act has been implemented

rows.source_ko: 3. 부두운영회사의 항만시설등의 분할 운영 여부 등 금지행위 위반 여부
rows.text_en: 3. Whether the dock operating company violated prohibited acts, such as whether it operated port facilities, etc. in a divided manner.
4. Whether other port operation contracts have been performed

rows.source_ko: ③ 관리청등은 제2항에 따른 검토 결과 부두운영계약을 갱신하려는 경우에는 갱신 계약기간이 시작되기 7일 전까지 해당 부두운영회사와 갱신계약을 체결하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ If the managing authority, etc. intends to renew a dock operation contract as a result of the review under Paragraph 2, it shall conclude a renewal contract with the relevant dock operating company no later than 7 days before the commencement of the renewed contract period. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 관리청등은 제3항에 따라 갱신계약을 체결하기 전에 갱신계약을 체결하려는 자가 제27조에 따른 부두운영회사의 선정기준에 적합한지 여부 등에 대하여 해양수산부장관과 미리 협의할 수 있다. <개정 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ④ Before concluding a renewal contract pursuant to Paragraph 3, the managing authority, etc. may consult with the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries in advance regarding whether the person intending to enter into a renewal contract meets the selection criteria for a dock operating company under Article 27 , etc. <Amended Oct. 14, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제29조의4(위약금의 부과) ① 법 제26조의7제1항 본문에 따른 위약금(이하 “위약금”이라 한다)은 부두운영회사가 부두운영계약 기간 동안의 총 화물유치 또는 투자 계획을 이행하지 못한 경우에 부과한다. 이 경우 위약금은 별표 4에 따라 연도별로 산정하여 합산한다. <개정 2020. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 29-4 (Imposition of Penalty Fees) ① Penalty fees pursuant to the main clause of Article 26-7, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “penalty fees”) shall be imposed in cases where a port operating company fails to fulfill its total cargo attraction or investment plan during the period of the port operation contract. In such cases, penalty feesshall be calculated annually in accordance with Annex 4 and aggregated. <Amended Mar. 13, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 관리청등은 제1항에도 불구하고 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 위약금의 전부 또는 일부를 감면한다. 이 경우 관리청등은 해양수산부장관과 미리 협의할 수 있다. <개정 2020. 3. 13., 2026. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, the managing authority, etc. shall reduce or waive all or part of the penalty for breach of contract in any of the following cases. In such cases, the managing authority, etc. may consult with the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries in advance. <Amended Mar. 13, 2020; Oct. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정부의 항만 개발에 관한 계획 등이 미이행되거나 연기되어 부두운영회사가 화물유치 또는 투자 계획을 이행하지 못한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where the terminal operating company fails to implement cargo attraction or investment plans due to the government's failure to implement or the postponement of port development plans, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 천재지변 등 부두운영회사에게 책임이 없는 불가항력적인 사유로 정상적인 경영이 불가능하다고 관리청등이 인정하는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where the administrative authority, etc., recognizes that normal business operations are impossible due to force majeure events, such as natural disasters, for which the port operating company is not responsible.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제29조의5(부두운영계약의 해지) 법 제26조의9제1항제3호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 사유”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 29-5 (Termination of Wharf Operation Contract) The term “reasons prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 26-9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act refers to any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. 부두운영회사가 부두운영계약 기간 동안 자기의 귀책사유로 법 제26조의6제2항제2호에 따른 투자 계획을 이행하지 못한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In the event that the port operating company fails to implement the investment plan under Article 26-6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act due to reasons attributable to itself during the port operating contract period

rows.source_ko: 2. 부두운영회사가 제29조제2호에 따른 항만시설등의 분할 운영 금지 등 금지행위를 한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where a dock operating company commits a prohibited act, such as the prohibition of divided operation of port facilities, etc. pursuant to Article 29, Subparagraph 2

rows.source_ko: 3. 정당한 사유 없이 부두운영회사가 제29조제3호에 따른 사항을 이행하지 아니한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. In the event that the dock operating company fails to perform the matters under Article 29, Subparagraph 3 without justifiable grounds
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]
Chapter 5 Supplementary Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제30조(미등록 항만에서의 일시적 영업행위) ① 항만운송사업자 또는 항만운송관련사업의 등록을 한 자는 영 제14조제2항에 따라 영업개시 3일 전까지 별지 제18호서식의 일시적 영업행위 신고서에 사업계획서을 첨부하여 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 12. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Temporary Business Activities in Unregistered Ports) ① A port transport business operator or a person registered for a port transport-related business shall, in accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, submit a report on temporary business activities in the form of Annex 18, attached with a business plan, to the head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or the governor of a city or province no later than three days prior to thecommencement of business operations. <Amended Dec. 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사는 제1항에 따라 일시적 영업행위 신고서를 받았을 때에는 영 제14조제1항에 따른 사유에 해당되는지를 확인한 후 별지 제18호서식의 일시적 영업행위 신고확인증을 신고인에게 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 12. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② When the head of a regional maritime and fisheries office or the mayor or provincial governor receives a report of temporary business activity pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall verify whether it falls under the grounds stipulated in Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, and then issue a certificate of confirmation of report of temporary business activity in the form of Annex 18 to the reporter. <Amended Dec. 28, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제30조의2(항만운송 종사자 등에 대한 교육훈련) ① 법 제27조의3제1항에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 안전사고가 발생할 우려가 높은 작업”이란 다음 각 호의 작업을 말한다. <개정 2020. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 30-2 (Education and Training for Port Transport Workers, etc.) ① In Article 27-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “work with a high risk of safety accidents as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the work set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 13, 2020>
1. Port cargo handling business under Article 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Act
2. Mooring port service business under Article 2, Subparagraph 1 , Item (b) of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제2조제1호다목 중 화물 고정 항만용역업
rows.text_en: 3. Port cargo fixing service business under Article 2, Subparagraph 1 , Item (c) of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 작업에 종사하는 사람은 법 제27조의3제1항에 따라 법 제27조의4제1항에 따른 교육훈련기관이 실시하는 교육훈련을 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 받아야 한다. <개정 2020. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: ② Persons engaged in work pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall receive education and training conducted by an education and training institution pursuant to Article 27-4 Paragraph 1 of the Act , in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs, pursuant to Article 27-3 Paragraph 1 of the Act. <Amended Mar. 13, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신규자 교육훈련: 제1항에 따른 작업에 채용된 날부터 6개월 이내에 실시하는 교육훈련
rows.text_en: 1. Training for New Employees: Training conducted within 6 months from the date of employment for the work pursuant to Paragraph 1

rows.source_ko: 2. 재직자 교육훈련: 제1호의 교육훈련을 받은 연도의 다음 연도 및 그 후 매 2년마다 실시하는 교육훈련
rows.text_en: 2. Education and training for incumbent employees: Education and training conducted in the year following the year in which the education and training under Item 1 was received, and every two years thereafter.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 교육훈련(이하 “교육훈련”이라 한다)의 내용ㆍ방법ㆍ시간 및 교육훈련의 유효기간은 별표 5와 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The content, method, time, and validity period of the education and training pursuant to Paragraph 2 (hereinafter referred to as “education and training”) are as set forth in Table 5 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제27조의4제1항에 따른 교육훈련기관은 교육훈련을 이수한 사람에게 교육훈련 이수증을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ An educational training institution pursuant to Article 27-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall issue a certificate of completion of education and training to a person who has completed the education and training.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제27조의3제2항 본문에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 작업”이란 제1항의 작업을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In the main text of Article 27-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “work prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the work in Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제27조의3제2항 단서에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 정당한 사유”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사유를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ In the proviso to Article 27-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “justifiable grounds prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to any of the following grounds:

rows.source_ko: 1. 교육훈련 수요의 급격한 증가에 따라 법 제27조의4제1항에 따른 교육훈련기관이 그 수요를 충족하지 못하는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 27-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act fails to meet the demand due to a rapid increase in the demand for education and training

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 제1항에 따른 작업에 종사하는 사람의 귀책사유 없이 교육훈련을 받지 못한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Any other cases where education and training were not received without fault attributable to the person engaged in the work under Paragraph 1
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 28, 2017]

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to the Imposition of Penalties)  The amended provisions of Article 29-4 shall also apply to port operating companies that are in the period of a port operation contract at the time of the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(화물 고정 항만용역업 종사자의 교육훈련에 관한 적용례) 이 규칙 시행 당시 제30조의2제1항제3호에 따른 화물 고정 항만용역업에 종사하고 있는 사람은 이 규칙 시행 후 1년 이내에 제30조의2제2항제2호에 따른 최초의 재직자 교육훈련을 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applicability to Education and Training of Workers in Fixed Cargo Port Services)  Persons engaged in fixed cargo port services pursuant to Article 30-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 at the time of enforcement of this Rule must receive the initial education and training for incumbent workers pursuant to Article 30-2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 within one year after enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(항만운송 종사자 등에 대한 재직자 교육훈련의 유효기간에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따라 받은 재직자 교육훈련의 유효기간은 제30조의2제2항제2호 및 별표 5 제2호의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따라 3년으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning the Validity Period of Education and Training for Incumbents in Port Transport Workers, etc.)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 30-2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 and Annex 5, Subparagraph 2, the validity period of education and training for incumbents received in accordance with the former regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be three years in accordance with the former regulations.
